skills.name: pipeline-run
skills.description: Run the full cargo-cicd pipeline: check, test changed, git status, workspace doctor, evidence doctor
skills.command: cargo make check && cargo cicd test changed && cargo cicd git status && cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd evidence doctor
skills.trigger: When user wants to run the full CI pipeline locally or verify workspace is ready to push

skills.name: evidence-doctor
skills.description: Emit and inspect process evidence, then invoke wasm4pm oracle for adjudication
skills.trigger: When user wants to check evidence gate status, verify wpm oracle, or prepare for release

skills.name: test-all
skills.description: Run all test suites including invariants, CLI, feature projection, autonomic policies, and git phase closure
skills.command: cargo test --test invariants && cargo test --test cli && cargo test --test feature_projection && cargo test --test autonomic_policies && cargo test --test git_phase_closure
skills.trigger: When user wants comprehensive test coverage beyond just cargo make test

skills.name: check-workspace
skills.description: Run full workspace health check: doctor, validate, list members, git status, policies
skills.command: cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd workspace validate && cargo cicd workspace list && cargo cicd git status
skills.trigger: When user wants a complete workspace health assessment before committing or pushing

skills.name: release-gate
skills.description: Run complete release gate: tests, invariants, evidence gate, workspace health — must all pass before tagging
skills.command: cargo make test && cargo test --test invariants && cargo test --test wasm4pm_evidence_gate && cargo cicd workspace doctor && cargo cicd evidence doctor
skills.trigger: When user wants to verify the workspace is ready for a version release, or to check all gates before tagging

directory_skills.name: evidence-audit
directory_skills.description: Explains and runs the process-evidence adjudication pipeline for cargo-cicd. Checks that XES event files exist under target/cargo-cicd/evidence/, invokes the receipt doctor via `cargo cicd evidence doctor`, runs `cargo cicd status audit`, and interprets the Accept or Refuse verdict from the wpm oracle. Notes that a missing wpm oracle exits non-zero with a BLOCKED diagnostic (expected in local dev environments).
directory_skills.trigger: When the user says 'audit evidence', 'check receipts', 'adjudicate', or asks whether process evidence was accepted

directory_skills.name: invariant-audit
directory_skills.description: Verifies the public-boundary invariants and output-substring contracts for cargo-cicd. Greps source, README, and docs for forbidden terms, runs the invariants/cli/feature_projection test suites, and confirms that each command prints the required output substrings.
directory_skills.trigger: When the user says 'check invariants', 'public boundary audit', 'verify contracts', or 'make sure the CLI output is correct' before a release or after changing a noun module

directory_skills.name: noun-scaffold
directory_skills.description: Scaffolds a new `cargo cicd <noun>` command with NounCommand + VerbCommand implementations, mod registration, main.rs wiring, UI output, evidence emission, and a projection test.
directory_skills.trigger: When the user says 'add a noun', 'new command', 'scaffold <noun>', or asks to extend the CLI with a new top-level subcommand

directory_skills.name: release-checklist
directory_skills.description: Runs a thorough pre-release gate for cargo-cicd: lint, type-check, full test suite, forbidden-term scan across source and docs, workspace doctor, status check, clean working tree verification, and commit-message format validation. Produces a go/no-go summary table.
directory_skills.trigger: When the user says 'release', 'ship', 'pre-release checklist', or asks whether the workspace is ready to publish

directory_skills.name: ui-component
directory_skills.description: Adds a new component to the `src/ui/` zero-dependency terminal design system, wires it into `src/ui/mod.rs`, enforces the color/glyph/width rules, adds `#[cfg(test)]` tests with caps overrides, and showcases it in `cargo cicd ui demo`.
directory_skills.trigger: When the user says 'add a UI component', 'new widget', 'add a <name> component to the design system', or needs a new terminal rendering primitive
